decisions_2026_11_19.source: the user's message of 2026-11-19 (close out the open porting blockers)
decisions_2026_11_19.note: RPV-27 (a)+(b) is one record; counted apart the keep decisions are 22; DBP-04 and DBP-05 are one record, IMP-20 is three records.

decisions.decision: A stored Bids.TakeoffIncrements of exactly 0 (also 0.0 / -0.0) keeps meaning snapping off on iOS; a NULL value loads as 1.0 (like Windows). No code change. Covers the aliases DBP-05, SNP-01, LP-19 and LOAD-01 (LOAD-01 is also an alias of DBP-03, which stays as it is).
Restoring a bid from Deleted Bids whose OrigBidProjectUID folder no longer exists restores it unassigned (Windows refuses the whole restore group). No code change. Covers the alias DBP-22.
Control characters (U+0000-U+001F, U+007F) are dropped from exported OBJ group / material names and DXF layer names; Windows keeps them. No code change.
Every exported OBJ mesh stays outward-facing, with or without a negative of another type in the export. No code change. Covers the alias MSH-M02 (same line as the decided EXP-M02 / GEO-15 / EXP-17).
CR and LF of a condition name are written as a space in the '# <name>' comment lines of the OBJ and the MTL (Windows writes the name raw, so a line break starts new statements). No code change.
Show All / Hide All change only the bid's own layers; the locked template layers shared with other bids are never written and a template-only entry cannot be toggled. No code change.
The view-dependent normal flip towards the viewer in the 3D lighting stays (option a of the earlier options); the shaders are not changed. No code change.

A DATETIME integer outside the C int range (for example "99999999999 1 1 0 0 0") stores NULL and the import goes on (Windows: OverflowError, the whole import fails and rolls back). No code change; the decided date rule itself (raw 6-part string, NULL when invalid) is fixed and tested.
BidTexts.Name and BidCallOuts.Name are stored as UTF-8 text (Windows: latin-1 bytes, raising for characters outside latin-1). No code change.
Memo and IMAGE (longbinary) text columns stay TEXT (Windows: UTF-8 BLOB). No code change.

A NULL stored RefNo counts as 'not the new number' and the condition update goes on (Windows: int(None) raises, update_condition returns False). No code change. Covers the aliases DLG-SAVE-01 and COND-M06.

Condition::cdn_type_name stays '' for a missing type (Windows: 'Unknown'); the dialog shows '(none)'. No code change. Covers the aliases QTY-20, DBP-32 and DBP-30; the type group title and the export material name still say 'Unknown' like Windows.

NameFontColor = 0 is also written explicitly on insert (kept). The DECISION TEXT is corrected: NameFontColor IS a Windows default (reference_schema_metadata.py:113), so the columns defaulted explicitly on insert are Count, GridOffsetX/Y, GridRotation, FontColor and NameFontColor. IsNegativeQuantity (also a Windows default, :111) is not in that list because insert_takeoff always writes it as a typed column with the takeoff's own flag (0 or 1), and the schema DEFAULT 0 covers rows created without it. No code change.

The iOS export error wording stays: 'Nothing to Export', 'Export Error ... The file could not be written.' and 'No Data' (Windows: 'Export Error: Error creating <fmt> export: Export function returned False'). No code change.
Exports use the sorted page order of the iOS selection (page names, file name and output order follow the page selector, not the Windows click order); EXP-18 stays. No code change.
The constant ost_footprint::kInteractivePdfRenderScale (3.0) is accepted: the minimum interactive sizes are 8/3 pt (count item) and 2/3 pt (linear band) on the iOS canvas. No code change.

(a) The negative marker anchor (area-weighted centroid of the region with a nearest-interior fallback) stays; (b) the marker position at the centroid of the displayed shape on rotated or flipped pages stays. No code change.
A page switch also clears the selected / place condition (and the FAB placement availability) unless a placement is in progress; Windows keeps the sidebar condition highlighted. No code change.
The batch insert of takeoffs validates in list order: a parent restored earlier in the same undo / redo step counts (Windows validates against the rows that exist before the batch). No code change.

Polygon validity for drag candidates is evaluated in OST coordinates (Windows: scene coordinates, which depend on the render view_scale). No code change. Also covers RPV-M01 where it names the same point.
A staging destination that is a directory counts as different content (a non-regular destination is never reused); Windows compares a directory size with a file size. No code change.

On a style change in a metric bid, the metric type defaults are persisted: style_dimension_defaults(type, metric) (spacing 100 mm / Area 150 mm; thickness 100 / 100 / 100 / 0 mm for Linear / Area / Count / Attachment), not the imperial table Windows writes (edit_condition_dialog.py:1445-1448). Deliberate deviation from the literal Windows behavior; the imperial behavior is unchanged and equals Windows. The spacing rule of the 2026-11-16 decision (a) is unchanged.

After a Save, is_top and z_value are derived from the condition name with extract_z_value_from_name (ost_domain::derive_elevation_from_name; an unreadable name gives 0.0 / false), so the in-memory condition equals what a reload gives. Deliberate deviation from the dialog's own values; it matches the effective Windows behavior, which reloads the conditions from the database after every save.

Whitespace-only Rise and Run are rejected with 'Rise must be a number.' / 'Run must be a number.' like Windows (only an EMPTY field is 0). ONLY this half is decided: the condition-number half (iOS refuses 2147483648 and up, Windows accepts up to the 64-bit column) is NOT decided and stays open.

'Count as Negative Quantity' changes ONLY the pressed takeoff, in ONE undoable entry (like Windows on_set_negative for a single selected takeoff). A condition that is merely selected in the sidebar no longer widens the change to every takeoff of the condition on the open pages.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: NULL / missing TakeoffIncrements loads as 1.0 (already ported)
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a defect.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: restore from Deleted Bids with a vanished OrigBidProjectUID fails the whole restore group
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a defect: a deliberate referential-integrity rule.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: NameFontColor default (iOS writes 0 on insert)
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a defect.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: export error text 'Export function returned False'
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a defect: deliberate and test-pinned wording.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: page order = click order in multi-page exports
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a defect: a harmless design choice.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: (2) BidTexts.Name and BidCallOuts.Name encoded as latin-1 bytes, raising for characters outside latin-1 (iOS stores UTF-8 text)
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a defect (on the import side): the legacy column is a latin-1 byte blob and Windows deliberately raises instead of silently replacing characters; decoding latin-1 never fails, so an OST/OSP produced by Windows always re-encodes.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: (3) memo and IMAGE (longbinary) text stored as a UTF-8 BLOB (iOS keeps TEXT)
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a defect: deliberate and consistent.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: cdn_type_name sentinel 'Unknown' in the loader (iOS keeps '')
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a defect: 'Unknown' for no type and for a dangling type uid is a deliberate loader convention, mirrored by the entity default and several consumers; the dialog hides it (uid lookup first, so a real type named 'Unknown' still works).

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: is_top / z_value taken from the dialog but memory comes from a reload
kept_not_a_defect.why: Nothing of consequence: the two DTO keys are never persisted and Windows reloads the conditions from the database after every save, so Windows memory always equals what a reload derives from the name.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: Normal flip in the 3D lighting (iOS flips towards the viewer, Windows orients normals to +z)
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a defect on its own: orienting shading normals to +z is deliberate and test-pinned, and the shader lights with the raw normal on purpose.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: Minimum interactive sizes (8 px count item / 2 px linear band at Windows view_scale 3.0; iOS uses 8/3 pt and 2/3 pt)
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a Windows defect: the minimums are fixed pixel constants in scene pixels and are consistent in the renderer and the drag/placement code.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: (a) negative marker anchor of an area with backouts (Qt subtracted-path point order versus iOS region centroid)
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a defect: Windows feeds the points of the Qt-subtracted path (several subpaths concatenated) into one polygon centroid, which is not the area centroid of the visible fill, but the contract (anchor inside the visible fill, with an interior fallback) is test-pinned and met.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: Page switch also clears the selected / place condition and the FAB placement availability on iOS (Windows keeps the sidebar condition highlighted)
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a defect: Windows drops the takeoff selection on a page switch (pinned) and leaves the sidebar condition highlighted; iOS clearing the condition as well is the safe direction.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: insert_takeoffs validates every parent against rows that exist BEFORE the batch (iOS accepts a parent restored earlier in the same batch)
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a Windows defect: Windows never restores a takeoff under its original uid (the writer allocates new uids), so a parent has to exist before the insert.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: drag validity (polygon_is_valid) evaluated on scene coordinates instead of OST coordinates
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a practical defect: validity is decided on coordinates scaled by OST * 72 * view_scale / scale_ratio, so for exactly collinear or touching (degenerate) polygons the answer can depend on floating-point rounding of that scale factor.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: HTML export includes hidden-layer conditions (iOS filters them)
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a defect: deliberate and test-pinned.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: export page and takeoff order follows the user's selection order (iOS sorts)
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a defect: deliberate and pinned.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: LZX and Quantum cabinet compression (iOS decodes stored and MSZIP only)
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a Windows problem.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: boolean columns: Windows writes the Access Yes/No true value (-1), iOS mixes 1 and -1
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a Windows defect.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: per-page selected area (BidPageSettings.BidAreaSelected) and inactive-area colouring
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a defect: a deliberate Windows feature (areas are surfaced there, not on iOS).

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: iOS-only Connect, Tolerance, Snap-to-Linear controls (Windows has no UI for those columns)
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a defect: the columns are part of the OST schema and Windows round-trips them untouched (its update writes only changed fields), it just has no UI for them.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: area meshes: Windows inward (negative signed volume), iOS outward
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a separate defect: inward in-memory winding of the area, linear and count generators is the Windows convention (the OBJ writer's face swap and the Python flip after the boolean are built around it).

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: flat quantized face shading on iOS instead of Windows' 60-degree crease-angle smooth shading
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a Windows defect: crease-angle smooth shading is the intended Windows look; flat shading on iOS is a deliberate rendering-layer choice (PORTING_LOG 2026-03-23).

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: curved linear takeoffs: no curved placement and no centre handle on iOS
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a Windows defect: Windows supports curved linears (arc band, three handles, 6-value position); iOS scope decision only.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: camera refit on every empty-to-non-empty page selection on iOS; Windows keeps the camera within a bid
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a Windows defect: the camera is fitted once per bid scene and kept across same-bid scene updates (pinned); the iOS transition refit is a deliberate iOS addition.

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: note 1: placement left running when the Image layer is hidden
kept_not_a_defect.why: Only an edge case: a condition assigned to the Image layer is hidden and unplaceable after the Image layer is hidden, while the placement tool stays armed (neither suspended nor restored).

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: whitespace-only Rise / Run: Windows rejects, old iOS accepted as 0
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a defect: Windows rejects whitespace-only Rise and Run with 'Rise must be a number.' / 'Run must be a number.' (an empty field means 0).

kept_not_a_defect.sub_item: 'Count as Negative Quantity' acts on the plan-view selected takeoffs only
kept_not_a_defect.why: Not a defect: Windows changes only the takeoffs passed in (the plan-view selection) and pushes one local history entry; this is the behaviour the iOS code change copies.
